async def gather_values(functions,limit):
    result = []
    done = [False] * len(functions)
    start = 0
    results = []
    async def execute(items, index):
        nonlocal start
        if index == len(items):
            return
        func = items[index]
        async def call_func():
            return func()
        result = await call_func()
        results.append(result)
        done[index] = True
        async for item in items[index + 1:]:
            execute(item, index)
    for i, func in enumerate(functions):
        execute([func], i)
    return results
